title: UAP science advisory committee's first Zoom meeting

tellings.quote: what we're worried about okay so this is a point of discussion in our first Zoom meeting was what if they misdirect us and go hey aby here's some stuff now go spend a few weeks analyzing that.

plain: In 2026 a White House science advisory committee on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs) held its first Zoom meeting, and one worry raised there was that officials might misdirect them: hand over some material and say "now go spend a few weeks analyzing that." Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic who sits on the committee, tells Michels this, naming the researcher Avi Loeb as the one who might be handed such material.
